description: This Java class `OpenConnection` defines a command that opens a specific connection within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing instances, parsing JSON representations, and managing connection identifiers and headers.

classes.name: OpenConnection
classes.description: A command class representing the action to open a Connection, including JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and string representation logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of OpenConnection with specified connection ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an OpenConnection instance from a JSON string or object, including JSON parsing and validation.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the connection to be opened.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of OpenConnection with specified headers.
